title: Operations Agent
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 4 skills: excel, word, customer service, admin. Likely PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Confirm Philippines eligibility before applying. Salary not disclosed
position_overview: Warehouse & Gateway Receipt of material from Couriers, resellers and Point of Sale (POS) to go out to the network. Transport of this material between the service center and the airport. Receipt of material upon the arrival at the airport The loading and off-loading of all outbound material on the international flight. This includes all necessary scans and alerts. The release and transport of outbound and inbound material out of the customs bond to the service center. The release and transport of relevant WPX out of the courier bond to the service center. Completing recovery reports Managing flight alerts 100% security scan of all outbound shipments, and storing of paperwork. Correct storing of all manifest Proper management and contact for all shipments to and from surrounding island via commercial uplift. COA/BOS report control AQCC monitoring X-Ray Scanning Key Qualifications: High School Diploma or Equivalent (GED) Valid Drivers License (Truck license) Police background clearance check and airport security vetting Must be 21 years old Excellent customer service skills Map reading and GPS skills and knowledge of delivery area preferred Physical Requirements: Must be able to lift up to seventy (70) lbs occasionally Must be able to lift forty (40) lbs frequently Must be able to walk, climb stairs, reach overhead, squat, bend, kneel, stoop and crouch repeatedly Please mention the word **UNCONDITIONAL** and tag ROjox when applying to show you read the job post completely (#ROjox). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
